requests.body: CI lint fails: ruff 0.16.9, the version .github/workflows/ci.yml pins, reports DTZ001 at tests/test_data.py:538, 559 and 561. Those naive datetimes are deliberate, because the tests check that a datetime is refused. Add # noqa: DTZ001 to each of the three, putting the parametrize values on separate lines so no line goes over 100 characters. Change nothing else.
